reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation exact-molecule, enzyme-family, botanical-phenotype, source/compartment, compound-specific ADME, or fatty-acid-specific exposure gate. They receive no marked prompt, generation call, or raster.
promotionRule: No Batch 088 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its identity, structure, organism, compartment, exposure, measurement, and evidence conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Host and microbial pathways, metabolites, diseases, and interventions are conflated, and PAH is wrongly called the catecholamine rate-limiting step.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split exact host/microbial reactions by analyte, enzyme/gene, organism, compartment, substrate/product, assay, cohort, causal tier, and endpoint.

routeDecisions.reason: A four-link stub merges human PDE5/cGMP pharmacology with bacterial cyclic-di-GMP enzymes and an unspecified universal zinc claim.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Create exact enzyme/protein records with organism, substrate/product, catalytic family, cofactor, structure, assay, inhibitor, and phenotype.

routeDecisions.reason: Natural hyperaccumulation, chelate-assisted extraction, ordinary crop uptake, BCF, food risk, rhizosphere biology, and remediation are conflated.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define accepted taxon, element species, natural substrate, shoot dry-weight threshold, voucher/locality, uptake/translocation factors, method, tolerance, and use status.

routeDecisions.reason: Distinct molecules and host, diet, microbial, cancer, immune, and experimental processes are presented as one dose-independent class effect.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by polyamine/pathway and define source, organism/cell, enzymes, reaction, concentration, sample, assay, exposure, outcome, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Thousands of compounds, foods, metabolites, metabotypes, chelation conditions, organisms, doses, and preclinical/clinical outcomes are generalized.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Create compound-specific records with identifier, matrix/dose, parent/metabolites, organism/enzymes, ADME, metal/assay conditions, trial endpoint, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: EPA, DHA, linoleic, arachidonic, and other PUFAs are merged with universal microbiome and inflammatory directions without exposure or evidence boundaries.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by exact fatty acid and define formulation/diet, dose, duration, population/model, sample, microbiome/lipid assay, endpoint, and evidence tier.
